SELECT TMP.finprodId, SUM(TMP.amount) as amount FROM ( SELECT CASE
WHEN A.FINPROD_ID=#{item} THEN #{item}
ELSE #{finprodId_qt} END AS finprodId, A.TDY_SHARE_AMT as amount FROM BOK_POSITION_PRD A WHERE 1=1
AND A.FINPROD_ID IN
null) OR A.FINPROD_ID in (
#{item}
AND A.BRANCH = 0 AND 1 = #{queryDate}-A.CDATE ) TMP GROUP BY TMP.finprodId

SELECT tmp.type, tmp.dateArea, tmp.areaIndex, SUM(tmp.AMOUNT) as amount FROM ( SELECT A.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, DECODE(C.FINPROD_TYPE2,#{finprodType2_1},#{finprodTypeRepoN},#{finprodType2_2},#{finprodTypeRepoN},#{finprodType2_3},#{finprodTypeRepo},#{finprodType2_4},#{finprodTypeRepo}) as type, (CASE WHEN C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area1BeginDate} AND #{area1EndDate} THEN #{area1} WHEN C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area2BeginDate} AND #{area2EndDate} THEN #{area2} WHEN C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area3BeginDate} AND #{area3EndDate} THEN #{area3} WHEN C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area4BeginDate} AND #{area4EndDate} THEN #{area4} WHEN C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area5BeginDate} AND #{area5EndDate} THEN #{area5} WHEN C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area6BeginDate} AND #{area6EndDate} THEN #{area6} ELSE '0' END) AS dateArea, (CASE WHEN C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area1BeginDate} AND #{area1EndDate} THEN '01' WHEN C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area2BeginDate} AND #{area2EndDate} THEN '02' WHEN C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area3BeginDate} AND #{area3EndDate} THEN '03' WHEN C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area4BeginDate} AND #{area4EndDate} THEN '04' WHEN C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area5BeginDate} AND #{area5EndDate} THEN '05' WHEN C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area6BeginDate} AND #{area6EndDate} THEN '06' ELSE '0' END) AS areaIndex, B.AMOUNT as amount
FROM FIN_PRODUCT_ADD A INNER JOIN PTL_SEC_POSITION B ON A.PORTFOLIO_ID = B.PORTFOLIO_ID AND 1 = #{queryDate}-B.CDATE AND B.HODING_TYPE = #{holdingType_SJ} INNER JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT C ON B.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID AND B.BRANCH = C.BRANCH AND C.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN (#{finprodType2_1},#{finprodType2_2},#{finprodType2_3},#{finprodType2_4}) WHERE 1=1
AND A.FINPROD_ID IN
null) OR A.FINPROD_ID in (
#{item}
AND C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area1BeginDate} and #{area6EndDate} ) tmp GROUP BY tmp.type, tmp.dateArea,tmp.areaIndex ORDER BY tmp.type,tmp.dateArea,tmp.areaIndex
